description: This file defines a Java interface named LoanScheduleWritePlatformService, which declares methods for adding and deleting loan schedule variations.

classes.name: LoanScheduleWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface for services that handle writing operations related to loan schedules, specifically adding and deleting variations.

methods.name: addLoanScheduleVariations
methods.description: Adds variations to a specified loan schedule identified by loanId, using data provided in the JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteLoanScheduleVariations
methods.description: Deletes variations from a specified loan schedule identified by loanId.
